rationale.A: Itämerenkatu/Hietalahdenranta-side path, then ~520 m in traffic on Hietalahdenranta and Telakkakatu, about 300 m of it on tram rails
rationale.B: Same corridor as A but rides in the carriageway on Itämerenkatu and Hietalahdenranta too: ~970 m in traffic, much of it on tram rails
rationale.C: Path beside Hietalahdenranta/Bulevardi, then 470 m in traffic on Albertinkatu (30 km/h, no tram rails); no tram-street riding
rationale.D: Porkkalankatu-side track, then 630 m in traffic on Hietalahdenkatu and Albertinkatu; 5 lights
rationale.E: Baana and quiet Lastenkodinkatu/Abrahaminkatu, then Albertinkatu (470 m in traffic); +3 min
rationale.F: Jätkäsaari start on quiet streets, then the same tram-railed Telakkakatu finish as A; +3 min
rationale.G: Like A plus Tehtaankatu tram rails; ~600 m in traffic; +5 min
rationale.H: Jätkäsaari detour with ~740 m in traffic, including Jätkäsaarenlaituri and the Telakkakatu tram rails; +5 min

notes: All streets are 30 km/h; the main hazard is tram rails on Telakkakatu and Hietalahdenranta. C removes them at no real time cost, so it gets the calm card. A has only 2 lights, so no fewest-lights card. A and B are grouped geometrically (track vs carriageway on the same streets), although B is clearly worse for calm.
